name: Open Objects Per wrok Team
query:
SELECT
    wt.name AS "Work Team ID:Link/Work Team:120",
    wt.team_name AS "Team Name::200",
    wt.team_leader AS "Team Leader:Link/User:150",
    COUNT(ps.name) AS "Total Open Projects:Int:150"
FROM
    `tabWork Team` wt
LEFT JOIN
    `tabProject Setup` ps
    ON wt.name = ps.work_team
    AND ps.status = 'Open'
GROUP BY
    wt.name, wt.team_name, wt.team_leader
ORDER BY
    wt.creation DESC
LIMIT 15;
